cues.text: So let's start with who's in the room.
They have a regular job, deadlines, an existing codebase, and teammates.
Every other day there's a new model, a new agent, or some revolutionary framework.
Meanwhile, someone on Twitter has apparently shipped an entire startup before lunch.
There's pressure to keep up, but not enough time or freedom to experiment with everything.
Someone is going to have to understand and maintain the code six months from now.
